summary.intent: Plan and execute Phase 45 of the cipher-box project — a Rust-only hygiene refactor of the FUSE write-journal/replay code across 7 scope items with no behavior changes.
summary.outcome: Phase 45 was fully planned (6 plans, 5 waves), verified with 0 blockers, and execution began: Wave 1 completed both plans (45-01 test safety net, 45-02 journal-dir helper), and Wave 2 plan 45-03 was in progress when the transcript ended.

repo: The FUSE crate is named `cipherbox-fuse` with default feature `fuse`; cargo commands must use `--package cipherbox-fuse --features fuse`.
Waves 2–5 are strictly serial because all four plans modify `crates/fuse/src/lib.rs` — only Wave 1 had true parallelism (45-01 and 45-02 have no file overlap).
Plan 45-02 discovered a third duplicate `journal_dir` call in `fuse/windows/mod.rs` beyond the two originally scoped — the Windows module is cfg-excluded on macOS so it was missed during research.
`fuse_abi.rs` carries pre-existing dead-code warnings from the vendored fuser ABI — unrelated to this phase, do not treat as regressions.
The rust-analyzer 'unlinked-file' diagnostic on `fuse/windows/mod.rs` is expected on macOS (cfg-excluded) — not an error.
`.planning/config.json` has `auto_advance: true`, which chains plan-phase directly into execute-phase unless the chain flag is cleared.
The API surface extractor returns 0 symbols for Rust — the regex is language-specific and doesn't cover Rust; skip passing it to the planner for Rust-only phases.

code.finding: Central file touched by all serial refactor waves (45-03 through 45-06); any parallel execution attempt on these plans would produce merge conflicts.
Contains a third duplicate `journal_dir` call that was out of scope in RESEARCH.md but was fixed opportunistically in plan 45-02.

workflow: The GSD commit helper can return a false-negative `commit_failed` even when lint-staged output shows success — always verify via `git log` when the helper reports failure.
Pattern mapper (gsd-pattern-mapper) runs after research and before planning; for this phase it found 3 analogs that informed the planner's file structure choices.
VALIDATION.md template placeholders (Test Infrastructure, Sampling sections) must be filled with real cargo commands before committing — the plan checker flags them as non-blocking warnings.
RESEARCH.md `Open Questions` sections should be marked `(RESOLVED)` after planning to satisfy the plan checker's non-blocking warning.

Worktrees can be technically enabled (`shouldDegrade: false`) but still be the wrong choice when all waves are serial single-plan chains — the workflow's `USE_WORKTREES=false` sequential path is fully supported and lower-risk in this scenario.
The `--auto --no-transition` flags suppress the post-execution transition prompt and enable unattended execution; flag parsing is strict (literal token presence only).

friction: Commit helper false-negative: reported `commit_failed` but the commit (`340e93efe`) had actually landed — required a manual `git log` verification step.
VALIDATION.md shipped with unfilled template placeholders that triggered a plan-checker warning and required a post-verification edit pass.
RESEARCH.md `Open Questions` heading was not marked resolved, also triggering a non-blocking checker warning requiring a second edit.
API surface extractor silently returned 0 symbols for Rust with no warning — the failure mode is invisible and could mislead planners on Rust-only phases.
Worktree parallelism decision had to be made manually by the orchestrator — the workflow doesn't auto-detect the 'all waves touch lib.rs' serial constraint.
open_items: Waves 2–5 (plans 45-03, 45-04, 45-05, 45-06) not yet executed — transcript ends mid-Wave 2 with 45-03 in progress.
Pre-existing dead-code warnings in `fuse_abi.rs` (vendored fuser ABI) — unaddressed by design but worth a future cleanup pass.
API surface extractor should be extended or configured to handle Rust symbols so planner context is richer for Rust-only phases.
The commit helper false-negative is a known issue but has no fix in place — a reliable exit-code wrapper would remove the mandatory git-log verification step.
